title: Treetop Friends!
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Milo the bluebird, and welcome to The Animated Zoo!
Today we're flying up high to meet five amazing treetop animals.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!

lines: Here's our first animal. Here's a clue: it swings from tree to tree! Can you guess?
First, swing over with me to the spider monkeys!
Spider monkeys live high up in the rainforest trees.
Spider monkeys live together in big family groups.
Can you swing your arms like a monkey? Swing, swing!
Can you guess what a spider monkey uses as an extra hand?
Its tail! A spider monkey can hang from a branch with its tail.
Let's say it together: SPIDER MONKEY!
Spider monkeys have long arms and legs, so they look a little like spiders.
They love to eat fruit, like figs.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it says hoo, hoo! Can you guess?
Now let's fly to the forest. Hoo, hoo! It's the owls!
Owls have big eyes to see in the dark.
Most owls sleep in the day, and wake up at night.
Can you turn your head slowly, like an owl? Look left. Look right!
Can you guess? Can an owl move its eyes?
No! So an owl turns its whole head instead. It can turn almost all the way around!
Owl feathers are super soft, so owls fly very quietly.
Shh! Can you be as quiet as an owl?
Who's next? Here's a clue: it's black and white, and it loves bamboo! Can you guess?
Next, let's visit the giant pandas!
Giant pandas love to eat bamboo. They munch for about half of the day!
Pandas have a special bump on their wrist that works like a thumb, to hold the bamboo.
Pandas also like to climb trees and roll around.
Can you pretend to munch bamboo like a panda? Munch, munch!
Can you guess how big a baby panda is when it's born?
Super tiny! About the size of a stick of butter. And it's pink!
Baby pandas grow up big and strong.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it's fluffy and gray, and it hugs trees all day! Can you guess?
Now let's climb up to the koalas!
Koalas live in eucalyptus trees and eat their leaves.
Koalas get most of the water they need from the leaves they eat.
Can you give a big tree hug like a koala? Hug, hug!
Can you guess how long koalas sleep?
Up to twenty hours a day! That's a lot of naps.
Koalas even have fingerprints, just like you!
A baby koala is called a joey.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it's the slowest animal in the trees! Can you guess?
Our last stop is the sloths. Let's go slowly!
Sloths hang upside down in the trees.
A sloth only comes down from its tree about once a week.
Can you move super slowly, like a sloth? Slooowly!
Can you guess why some sloths look a little bit green?
Because they move so slowly, tiny green plants called algae grow on their fur!
The green helps sloths hide in the leaves.
And guess what? Sloths are good swimmers too!

recap: What a treetop adventure! Let's remember.
Spider monkeys use their tails like a hand.
Owls turn their heads instead of their eyes.
Baby pandas are as small as a stick of butter.
Koalas sleep up to twenty hours a day.
outro: Which animal was your favorite? Remember, be kind to every animal. Watch quietly and give them space.
Bye, friends! See you at the zoo!
